cells.tense: You are standing where everything is still possible and nothing has been decided yet
cells.act: choose the light to steer by and turn toward it
cells.ask: Let yourself want a particular direction for the care you've got going, quietly, with no route worked out.
cells.core:
Standing where everything is still possible isn't standing still. You can still see the patch you're working with, and you haven't forced it into a shape it isn't ready for. That's the strength here. Openness by itself doesn't aim anything, though. When you know which way you want it to lean, the care stops being only keeping and starts being pointing. Some days the patch just gets water and no attention, and that's fine, because you're still facing the same way.

Let yourself want a particular direction for the care you've got going, quietly, with no route worked out. Wanting it is the whole turn. Nothing else has to close off to do it, and nobody else needs to hear it. What you're growing stays open at the top — now it has a heading too.

cells.verb: Holding all of it open before anything is chosen

cells.tense: You are holding every possible version of this at once and none has touched ground
cells.act: do one thing today the way only you do it, and do not explain it
cells.ask: Pick any ordinary task today and do it in your own particular way, then leave it without a word of explanation.
cells.core:
Carrying every possible version at once has become its own kind of work. Each morning the options get weighed again, and the weighing feels like care. But nothing has gone into soil, and the hovering has grown wider than the thing it hovers over. Your shoulders know it. What's already in your hands is small, unfinished, real, and the only thing that will grow.

Pick any ordinary task today and do it in your own particular way, then leave it without a word of explanation. Plain and specific, not a plan for a plan. Doing it once, at its own size, shows you what you actually have, and the ground under it firms up. The choice doesn't need defending. It only needs making.

cells.tense: You are tending from a closed-up place and the care comes out tight
cells.act: look at the same thing longer, until it shows you more
cells.ask: Rest your eyes on something you care about past the usual glance, and ask it for nothing while you do.
cells.core:
The care still comes out of you, but tight, as if there isn't enough of it to go around. You tend what's here from behind a grip you can feel in your hands and jaw. Where the grip came from isn't the question now. What matters is that this part of you didn't shut — it's there, just no longer expected to be used.

Rest your eyes on something you care about past the usual glance, and ask it for nothing while you do. Stay with it and see what shows up when you're not trying to move it along. Staying loosens the grip, and the grip is what's been doing the damage. You don't have to feel hopeful first. Looking is the first true move, and it needs nothing from you but the time.

cells.tense: You are answering the day as it arrives without noticing the choices already made
cells.act: picture it a year on, turned out well, and keep the picture
cells.ask: Sit five minutes with the patch you're working and let a good version of it a year out be visible to you.
cells.core:
Answering the day as it arrives has become the whole method. Most of what you do for everything you're tending is a response to whatever is directly on you. Options were there. You didn't see them close because you weren't looking at them at all. This is the older habit, the one that started when too much came at once — it kept running long after the pressure let up, and it's still steering you. The image is still in you. You just haven't been letting it show.

Sit five minutes with the patch you're working and let a good version of it a year out be visible to you. Not a plan, not a promise: a picture made from what you've already lived. The fog doesn't have to lift for this. Let the good shape be visible to yourself, and the choices you've been missing start to appear.
